status: pre-registered; written while the step-9 fine-tunes train; no stacked arm scored

feature.source: their full recipe (multitask + LIGYSIS, train.ipynb cell 16, their finetuning_utils verbatim), clean variant (deploy/s2p_finetune_modal.py::finetune_full, run s2p_full_20261006)
feature.clean_rule: each model's LIGYSIS stage also drops every LIGYSIS protein >= 40 % identical over >= 50 % coverage to any protein the model scores held-out (finetuned_esm/ligysis_exclusions.json): clean_all -> test, clean_h -> fold h
feature.assignment: train-fold-h rows <- clean_h; test rows <- clean_all
feature.conditional_on: 9d gate (exact_all reproduces the released model within ±0.015 AUC / ±0.03 AUPRC pooled) and 9e gate (every held-out fold scores like unseen data); if either fails, nothing below is run
feature.table: build/residues_s2pfull.parquet = residues_s2p.parquet + s2pfull_oof, row order unchanged

protocol.harness: deploy/s2p_stack.py deployed with S2P_STACK_TABLE=residues_s2pfull.parquet; same context draw (budget 50,000, seed 0), tabicl 2.1.1
protocol.gate: control arm on train-fold-0 from the new table must equal build/cv_scores/k64_train-fold-0.json exactly
protocol.threshold: per fold at mean per-protein FPR 0.05, frozen = median of four; computed and written before test is read
protocol.test: both arms scored on test once
protocol.known_issue_not_fixed: step 8f showed the CV-frozen threshold overshoots on test (FPR 0.098) because the all-folds model's scores run hotter than the fold models'. The user chose not to fix this; threshold metrics are reported as they fall and are not claimed.

references_on_test.full_alone: clean_all's score on test (the component being stacked)
references_on_test.fixed_blend: 0.5 * within-protein percentile rank of tabicl_117 + 0.5 * that of full_alone
references_on_test.released_context_only: the released model's step-5 scores; contaminated on 25 test proteins (9b), so compared only on the 206 non-leaked proteins and never claimed

metrics: AUC and AUPRC per protein and pooled, on CB-full (231) and CB-P2RANK-apo (184); paired bootstrap over proteins, 10,000 resamples per-protein, 2,000 pooled, seed 0

claims.primary: s2pfull_117 minus full_alone, per-protein AUPRC, CB-full: paired 95 % CI entirely above zero
claims.secondary_1: s2pfull_117 minus tabicl_117, same metric and criterion
claims.secondary_2: s2pfull_117 minus fixed_blend, same metric and criterion
claims.secondary_3: s2pfull_117 minus s2pfull_53, same metric; reported either way
claims.secondary_4: s2pfull_117 minus s2p_117 (does a stronger component make a better stack), same metric and criterion
claims.reported_not_claimed: pooled AUPRC on CB-P2RANK-apo (the papers' convention); every arm vs the released model on the 206 non-leaked test proteins

known_caveat: As in step 8: in CV job h the context rows' scores come from fold models that trained on fold h. CV only sets the threshold; no model behind any feature value saw a protein it scores, in either stage.
